notes: Held-out research questions answered by documents assigned to Wikisource volume p000. Questions paraphrase the source; they do not copy its title.

What protections did the 1864 agreement give to wounded soldiers and to medical workers on the battlefield?

How does the argument begin that people are born free yet everywhere live under chains?
